findings.claim: The change edits `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` even though this change explicitly declared editing that file out of scope and reserved constraint updates for `/kbd-init --force`.
findings.evidence: design.md Non-Goals says "Editing `.kbd-orchestrator/project.json` or `constraints.md`; the owner re-runs `/kbd-init --force`" and tasks.md 4.2 says to tell the owner to re-run `/kbd-init --force`; the diff modifies `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` and changes the `no-console-log-in-lib` check.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert all `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` edits in this change and leave constraint regeneration to `/kbd-init --force`.

findings.claim: The new test file violates the active blocking `no-console-log-in-lib` constraint because it contains `console.log` under `lib/*.mjs`.
findings.evidence: The packet's blocking constraint `no-console-log-in-lib` checks `git grep --no-index --exclude-standard -n -E -e "console\.(log|debug)" -- "lib/*.mjs" "rules/lib/*.mjs"`; the diff adds `spawnExecutable(process.execPath, ['-e', 'console.log(JSON.stringify(process.argv.slice(1)))', ...hostile])` in `lib/platform/spawn.test.mjs`.
findings.suggested_fix: Avoid the literal `console.log` in `lib/platform/spawn.test.mjs`, for example by writing to `process.stdout` in the child fixture, or move the fixture out of the constrained path without editing the constraint.
